NVA, in collaboration with an energy auditor, adjusted the project scope to fit a reduced budget, which included upgrades in HVAC (replacing thermostats and improving hydronic heating systems) and lighting (replacing with LED). In June 2023, the NREL project manager contacted multiple HVAC and electrical engineering vendors, receiving three HVAC bids and one electrical bid by the July deadline. NVA selected the most cost-effective HVAC bid with guidance from the energy auditor and negotiated additional work with the electrical vendor, leading to a modified bid by late July. Necessary materials were ordered; the maintenance director prepared the facility for construction and was present during the installation of new systems and equipment. Obtaining vendor approval from the DOE was delayed (even with assistance from DOE staff), as the lead agency’s attention was temporarily directed toward supporting a new round of projects, which pushed review of existing projects like ours off for several weeks.
